SourceProxy.label: SHYX Vessel End Clipper
SourceProxy.name: SHYXVesselEndClipper

Documentation.short_help: SHYX Vessel End Clipper: Clips vessel tips flat at skeleton endpoints for CFD.

SourceProxy.Documentation:
This filter clips the tips of a vascular surface mesh at the leaf endpoints of its centerline skeleton. A cutting plane perpendicular to the local centerline tangent is placed at each degree-1 vertex, producing flat cross-sections suitable for CFD inlet/outlet boundaries.
Inputs: - Port 0 (Input): the original vessel surface mesh (vtkPolyData) - Port 1 (Centerline): the extracted centerline, e.g. from SHYX Skeleton Extraction (vtkPolyData with lines)
Outputs: - Port 0 (Clipped Mesh): the vessel mesh with tips clipped - Port 1 (Clip Planes): visualization of endpoint positions and clip plane normal directions (lines + point data)

InputProperty.name: Input
InputProperty.Documentation: The vessel surface mesh to clip.

InputProperty.name: Centerline
InputProperty.Documentation: The centerline skeleton of the vessel (e.g. output of SHYX Skeleton Extraction). Clipping planes are placed at all degree-1 (leaf) vertices.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: ClipOffset
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Clip Offset
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Offset distance to shift each cutting plane along the centerline tangent. Positive values move the plane outward (away from vessel body), negative values move it inward. Default is 0.

IntVectorProperty.name: TangentDepth
IntVectorProperty.label: Tangent Depth
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Number of skeleton edges to walk inward from each leaf node when estimating the local tangent direction for the cutting plane. Larger values produce a smoother, more averaged tangent; smaller values follow the skeleton more locally. Default is 1.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: MinBranchLength
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Min Branch Length
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Minimum centerline branch length (arc length from each leaf endpoint to the nearest bifurcation, or to the opposite leaf when there is no junction) for that endpoint to be checked by default in **Endpoints to Clip**. Shorter branches are left unchecked (typical short side branches or stubs). Set to **0** to disable auto-filtering and check all endpoints. Apply once after changing centerline input so endpoints are discovered.

IntVectorProperty.name: CapEndpoints
IntVectorProperty.label: Cap Endpoints
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: If ON, the holes created by clipping are filled using CGAL polygon mesh processing to produce a closed (watertight) mesh suitable for CFD meshing. Requires the input vessel mesh to be closed.

IntVectorProperty.name: FairingContinuity
IntVectorProperty.label: Capping Fairing Continuity
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: When Cap Endpoints is ON, controls the tangential continuity of the filled patches (CGAL fairing_continuity): 0 for C0 (planar-style), 1 for C1, 2 for C2. Default is 0.

StringVectorProperty.name: EndpointStatus
StringVectorProperty.label: Endpoints to Clip
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Select which endpoints to clip. Each entry corresponds to a degree-1 leaf vertex of the input centerline. Only checked endpoints will be clipped. Apply once first to discover the endpoints from the centerline input. **Min Branch Length** controls which endpoints are checked by default (short branches unchecked).

IntVectorProperty.name: UseUpdateAttributes
IntVectorProperty.label: Interpolate attributes
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: If ON, attributes will be interpolated unto the resulting mesh.

IntVectorProperty.name: UseInteractiveCutPlanes
IntVectorProperty.label: Show Interactive Cut Planes
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: When ON, yellow per-endpoint plane widgets are shown in the view so you can edit cut planes. Turning it OFF only hides the widgets; clipping still uses the last plane state from InteractiveCutPacked when present. Apply once so endpoints are discovered, select a row under Endpoints to Clip, adjust the plane, then Apply again to clip.

StringVectorProperty.name: InteractiveCutPacked
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Internal: packed interactive state (6 whitespace-separated doubles per endpoint: origin xyz, direction-handle xyz). Managed by the custom panel widget.

StringVectorProperty.name: OutputMessage
StringVectorProperty.label: Last update reason
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Read-only text from the last pipeline update: why RequestData ran and relevant MTime values. The same line is printed to View → Output Messages (vtkWarningMacro).
